settings.title: Where do they go, and what do they get up to?
settings.text:
• The backyard mystery. Out for an hour, back with leaves in the fur and no explanation.

settings.title: How it works
settings.step1_text: Hold the button: the camera switches on and starts recording.
settings.step2_text: Slide the mount onto their collar so the lens sits under the chin, facing forward.
settings.step3_text: When they're back, take it off and watch the video on your phone.

settings.title: Good to know before you buy
settings.text:
• Let your pet get used to the collar and camera at home first, for a few minutes at a time.
  • Use it on a well-fitting collar, never on a choke or prong collar. Two fingers should fit under the collar.
  • Don't leave your pet unsupervised with it for long periods, and take it off for sleep.
  • Not a GPS tracker. It films, it doesn't show where they are live.
  • Check the camera's water rating before rain or swimming.
